title: Doc comment restates the signature and narrates the loop
description: Doc comment restates what the function signature already declares and narrates loop steps that will silently go stale when code changes. Delete the block; name, parameter types, and return type carry the essential facts.

title: Four inline comments each restate the line beneath them
description: Four inline comments (lines 16, 18, 20, 23) restate their statements verbatim. Reader parses each twice and learns nothing from the repetition. Delete all four; loop body is self-describing.
